newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SGB WANTS TO KEEP MAJORITY IN TRACTEBEL-ELECTRABEL.
newsitem.headline: SGB WANTS TO KEEP MAJORITY IN TRACTEBEL-ELECTRABEL.

text.p: Belgian holding firm Societe Generale de Belgique (SGB) said on Wednesday it wanted to keep the majority holding in a possible future Tractebel -Electrabel if the two utility units merge.
"(SGB) wants to hold the majority in any possible new entity," an SGB spokesman told Reuters.

SGB had said earlier on Wednesday it had no objection to a possible merger of Electrabel and Tractebel and was even willing to see its stake in such a future, merged Tractebel-Electrabel diluted to below 50 percent as long as it remained the controlling shareholder. SGB currently has 65 percent of Tractebel. That will fall to just over 50 percent in October when Tractebel finalises a merger with its foreign energy unit Powerfin .
